pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome to Weston Green | Prep School & Nursery | Surrey |
pageCache.text:
Weston Green School
Nurturing and Quality Education for Children in Surrey
Welcome to Weston Green School, your leading prep school in Thames Ditton Surrey. We provide quality education in a nurturing environment where ambition, curiosity and kindness shape every aspect of our pupils’ school life.
These values are not just words on a wall, they guide how we teach, how we play and how we grow together. From Little Prep to Year 6, our pupils thrive in small classes led by passionate teachers who know them well and believe in their potential.
We are a school where children build confidence, find their voice, and lay the best possible foundation for their education.
Find out more about us, contact us to discuss your child or enquire now to begin the enrolment process.
Begin your journey
Simple and Intuitive School Fees
We are also pleased to offer interest-free monthly payments to our parents via direct debit.
Prep School
At Weston Green, we provide amazing preparatory school and nursery facilities. These facilities come with dedicated and expert teachers, small class sizes for a personalised approach, and a curriculum tailor-made for you child’s academic success. Whether you’re joining us from our nursery or starting fresh at our preparatory school, we are here to help. We make it our mission to ensure all of our pupils succeed and thrive in a welcoming and inclusive environment.
Nursery
Weston Green Nursery is all about engaging our young pupils in the joy of discovery. Our nursery teachers combine play and education for a fun learning experience that lays the groundwork for the years to come.
With teachers specialising in foundational learning, invigorating outdoor activities and lessons, and an inclusive and accepting atmosphere, we create the perfect space for your child to thrive.
Academic Excellence at Weston Green School
Bright Beginnings
Our Bright Beginnings curriculum for our nursery pupils is our way of laying the best possible groundwork our pupils. During this time, we use play to engage children in the basics of learning. Not only is this an effective way for them to learn, but it also creates positive and nurturing experiences that inspire our young learners to enjoy and engage in school moving forwards.
Prep Curriculum
We take a personal approach to learning, encouraging our pupils to be proactive and mindful. Our prep curriculum is carefully structured to help them meaningfully connect with subjects, deepening their understanding by inspiring genuine interest and passion in what they study.
Future Skills
We understand that, as a nursery and preparatory school, we represent the first steps on our pupils’ academic journey, but certainly not the last. Our future skills programme teaches our students the skills that they will need to thrive as they move on to the next stage of their academic journey.
From creative thinking to digital literacy to problem solving, we ensure that our children have both the academic and the practical skills they need to thrive.
A Nurturing and Personalised School Life
Every child at Weston Green School receives the individual attention they need to thrive. We achieve this through both small class sizes and personalised lesson plans that are tailored to each class.
It is this attention to detail and pastoral care that helps us to create the nurturing environment our pupils need. We ensure that they feel supported, valued, and confident in themselves and their abilities.
What's New at Weston Green?
Year 4 pupils have been busy in our new Art Studio as they begin a fascinating topic on sea scapes. 🍴 Studying the work of Alice Kettle, the children experimented with different tools to make sea, water and waves 🌊 Later in the term they will add embroidery to complete their finished sea scapes 🖌️ Our lovely Art Studio provides all our pupils with the perfect space to experiment and learn different techniques under the expert supervision of our Head of Art, Mrs Russell. #westongreenschool #prepschool #thamesditton #esher #claygate
Soft play is back! If the rain has left you wondering how to entertain your little one, why not come along to our Wednesday morning soft play sessions? Sessions begin on Wednesday 9th September and continue throughout the term.Free of charge and a whole lot of fun. Sign up via the link in our bio or via the website.#WestonGreenSchool #toddlergroup #ThamesDitton #Esher #Molesey #Surbiton #Claygate #preschoolclasses
Diary at the ready - make sure your make a note of these important dates for some of our most anticipated events of the year!Our much loved FREE SOFT PLAY sessions return for the autumn on Wednesday 9th September. Places are limited so make sure you sign up via the link in our bio and come and enjoy a stress-free and friendly start to your Wednesday morning.Our AUTUMN TERM OPEN DAY is taking place on Friday 9th October from 9.15am. Sign up via the link in our bio and enjoy the chance to see our brilliant little school in action. Whether you are considering a mid-year change or a planning ahead to September 2027 or 2028, please come along and see Weston Green for yourself. If your child is due to start RECEPTION in 2027 make sure you consider Weston Green School. We accept applications from external pupils (as well as those in our pre-Reception class) and host several events throughout the year to give parents the opportunity to see why our families love Weston Green. Come along to our open day, or get in touch to find out about some of our other activities for pre-Reception children. #westongreenschool #prepschool #ReceptionatWGS #Reception2027 #openday #toddlergroup
Welcome back to all our pupils, staff and parents!Whether it’s the start of a brand new chapter or a return to familiar friends and faces, the best thing about being a part of Weston Green School is that there is always a friend nearby. 💜Welcome back everyone! Here’s to a busy, exciting and memorable year ahead. #westongreenschool #thamesditton #esher #claygate #surbiton
Following some competitive bidding at the Parents Association Summer Party, a band of Weston Green students took to the famed Twickenham rugby pitch as part of the Allianz Future Stars Takeover. Not only was it a fun day out for all the family, but the students were treated to specialist coaching from a variety of rugby stars such as Dan Biggar, Danny Care, Shaunagh Brown, Jasmine Joyce and Sarah Bern, as well as training sessions from The Rugby Trainer and a behind-the-scenes tour of the changing rooms and tunnel. 🙏 A huge thanks goes to Mike Thomas at Allianz for donating the prize and making a Twickenham dream come true.#WestonGreenSchool #PrepSchoolSurrey #ThamesDitton #LongDitton #Esher #claygate #Molesey #Surbiton @allianztwickenham #WGSAmbition #WGSCuriosity #WGSKindness
🗞Year 6 Make Headlines!🗞🎭 One of the many highlights of the Summer Term was our Upper Prep Production.📰 This year, the children tackled the junior version of hit Broadway musical Newsies, and they truly rose to the challenge, delivering a professional and memorable performance. As always, our staff pulled out all the stops to ensure the production was a roaring success. Thanks go to them, our parents and, of course, the wonderful children!A big shout out must go to Nick at @studio_d_music for his generosity, patience and support with audio and mics. READ ALL ABOUT IT on our website westongreenschool.org.uk/news-events/news/📸 #SimonDrakePhotography
🦘A "long jump" to Birmingham!🦘Following his success in the long jump at the ISA Regional Athletics Competition, Dougie went on to represent London South at the ISA National meet in Birmingham on the 15th May. Finishing 6th in the country, he was up against some very tall and bouncy competition, but did us proud and has set himself some new targets for a PB next year. Great job, Dougie - and what a great experience!#WestonGreenSchool #PrepSchoolSurrey #ThamesDitton #LongDitton #Esher #claygate #Molesey #Surbiton #sport #ISASport#WGSAmbition #WGSCuriosity #WGSKindness
What a week that was! 🌞The Year 6 Residential is a highlight for all Weston Green pupils, as they mark the end of their prep school journey with an action-packed week in Somerset. 🚣With the weather on their side, this year`s gang took full advantage of their coastal location and enjoyed raft building, cliff jumping and body-boarding. 🏖Plenty of time on the beach, playing games on the grass and a good amount of hiking made for a brilliant, old-fashioned antidote to day-to-day life.🏫As they look ahead to pastures new and the formative experience of going from being one of the biggest to one of the smallest, we are sure of one thing: these young people are absolutely ready to take on the challenges and opportunities that await them at their new schools. Whilst they will certainly make new friends, they will be secure in the knowledge that they will always have friends in their Weston Green peers, teachers and the wider community. #WestonGreenSchool #PrepSchoolSurrey #ThamesDitton #LongDitton #Esher #claygate #Molesey #Surbiton #schooltrip #educationalvisit #11plus #WGSAmbition #WGSCuriosity #WGSKindness
Well it’s safe to say that this trip will be remembered for more than just the beautiful blue skies and brilliant fun (IYKYK) but wow what a lot of fun it was!Our pupils showed teamwork, resilience, bravery, joy, camaraderie, laughter and so many other skills and qualities during their final WG trip. Thank you to the children, teachers and instructors for making it so memorable and we hope you always look back on it with a smile! @landandwave #westongreenschool #thamesditton #schooltrip #residential #Dorset
🎪🌷Claygate Village and Flower Show🌷🎪🎨 Lots of our pupils have been working hard to create their colourful entries for this year`s Claygate Village and Flower Show. 😎 Following on from last term`s #SkillQuest theme, our children were set up beautifully to embrace the theme of COLOUR! 🌟 The children have had brilliant fun in the Art Studio brining their pieces to life.🎪They have created some wonderful pieces and we look forward seeing them displayed as part of the exhibition this weekend. We hope to see you there!@claygateflowershow #Claygate #claygateflowershow #WestonGreenSchool #PrepSchoolSurrey #ThamesDitton #LongDitton #Esher #Molesey #Surbiton #WGSAmbition #WGSCuriosity #WGSKindness
Year 2 have been putting their knowledge of position and direction into action by navigating their own grids using left ⬅️, right ➡️, forwards ⬆️ and backwards ⬇️. They worked brilliantly to follow and give instructions to move accurately around the grid like real mathematicians! 📍🧠#westongreenschool #thamesditton #esher #surbiton
In our final rehearsals before this evening’s first Newsies performance we managed to capture a few sneaky clips. Enjoy! #westongreenschool #Newsies #performingarts
Our Reviews
We all miss it so much, it was a magical time for both my boys and it’s set them up so well for their continued learning.
Support for the 11+ exams, the interesting and engaging way the curriculum is taught and challenging the children to think beyond the subject being taught. Support for the child’s personal development and encouragement to be the best version of themselves.
Have been impressed with every area of the school, from the quality of teaching to the time taken to understand the kids. Gets to know their strengths and weaknesses and help them develop personally and academically. Really like the focus on sport, music, drama and the range of clubs, supplementing academic achievement and discovery.
The school creates an inclusive atmosphere where all the children are encouraged to participate and get to know each other, even across year groups. The small class sizes enable staff to provide a greater degree of focus to each child’s learning than in other schools.
It has been an absolute privilege to have been a parent at this school and have my children taught and cared for by such a wonderful group of caring and nurturing people. Everyone of you have contributed to their education and they wouldn’t be the young people they are without your guidance.
Future Schools and Destinations
Join Weston Green School
Looking for a private school in Surrey that combines academic excellence with a nurturing environment? You are already in the right place. Weston Green School is the ideal choice. Enquire now to get started on your child’s application or contact us for more information.
Our friendly staff are always happy to walk prospective parents through any information they may need to make the best possible decision for their child.

pageCache.pageTitle: Bright Beginnings Curriculum | Pre Prep School | Weston Green
pageCache.text:
Inspiring early learning with purpose, wonder and joy
At Weston Green Little Prep, our bespoke Bright Beginnings curriculum gives children a joyful and meaningful start to their education. Rooted in the Early Years Foundation Stage and enriched with real-life experiences, it goes beyond national expectations to nurture confident learners who are ready to take on the world.
Play with purpose
We believe the best learning happens when children are deeply engaged in what they are doing. That is why play is central to the Bright Beginnings approach. Through role-play, exploration, storytelling and hands-on activities, children build early foundations in literacy, numeracy, science and the wider world in ways that feel natural and exciting.
You might find children running a café, investigating shadows outside or building with purpose in construction areas. Each experience is carefully shaped to introduce key skills while fostering creativity, independence and joy.
Personalised progress for every child
No two learners are the same. In Little Prep, we take time to understand each child’s interests, development and preferred ways of learning. Our practitioners use rich interactions and ongoing observation to shape each child’s journey. Some children flourish through early mark-making while others thrive in movement, music or imaginative play. Every step forward is noticed, celebrated and used to guide what comes next.
Themes that spark curiosity
Each half term is framed by an engaging theme that links learning across subjects. From ‘Under the Sea’ to ‘People Who Help Us’, these projects inspire deep thinking, big questions and active involvement. Children are co-creators of the curriculum, helping shape where their learning goes next. Afternoons offer even more freedom for children to pursue their own interests through exploration, collaboration and discovery.
Specialist sessions that enrich and excite
Bright Beginnings is enhanced by weekly specialist sessions in music, French, sport and Movement and Mindfulness. These lessons develop coordination, expression, emotional awareness and a love of learning across disciplines.
Our subject leaders also deliver themed enrichment days throughout the year, from Maths Investigations to Autumn Art Week. These are memorable, hands-on days that give children the chance to explore new ideas and discover hidden talents.
Laying strong foundations for school and beyond
Bright Beginnings is carefully designed to prepare children for their next steps into Reception and school life. Children begin to develop phonics and early writing through the Sounds-Write programme, explore number fluency through maths mastery and build the focus, independence and social awareness they will need as they grow.
Our pre-Reception programme introduces more formalised learning in a way that keeps curiosity and kindness at the heart. Children step into school life with confidence, resilience and pride in how far they have come.
Driven by values, guided by curiosity
Our curriculum is brought to life by Weston Green’s values of ambition, curiosity and kindness. Every experience is shaped to stretch thinking, encourage thoughtful questions and nurture warm relationships. At Little Prep, we believe that early learning should inspire, uplift and lay the groundwork for a future filled with purpose.

pageCache.pageTitle: Meet our Head | Private School Thames Ditton | Weston Green
pageCache.text:
A warm welcome to Weston Green School!
I extend you a very warm welcome to Weston Green School.
At Weston Green, we combine a strong sense of kindness, academic rigour and ambition for all, along with outstanding pastoral care. This inclusive environment provides the backdrop for our world-class and relevant curriculum, resulting in children who are self-assured, inspired, happy, successful, and confident in being themselves.
The world is changing rapidly, and alongside a strong focus on Mathematics and English, our wide-ranging curriculum is designed with future skills in mind. Starting from the age of two, and guided by specialist teachers, our children develop the crucial social, critical thinking, and technological skills they will need for the rest of their lives. They learn to evaluate the world around them, make sound judgments, and form reasoned, balanced, and empathetic opinions. The opportunities afforded to children at Weston Green allow them to find their passions and talents, which in turn breeds pride and confidence. We believe that a strong primary education is the foundation for future success, and we are passionate about equipping our students with the best possible life chances.
If you’re fortunate enough to live in the vicinity of Weston Green, you have access to some of the country’s finest secondary schools. Choosing the right one for your child can feel overwhelming, especially when they’re very young. At Weston Green, we provide comprehensive preparation for entrance exams in an inclusive and non-pressurised environment, encouraging each child to do their very best. Our skilled and dedicated teachers support both children and parents every step of the way, helping to achieve their full potential, ease anxiety and build a culture of striving for excellence. This approach allows families the freedom to choose the secondary school that best fits their child and we are very proud of our success in this area.
Visit Us
I would be delighted to show you around our friendly school and discuss how Weston Green can help your children flourish and thrive. I look forward to welcoming you soon.
Mr David Brown Headteacher

pageCache.pageTitle: Extra-Curricular/Clubs | Private School Surrey | Weston Green
pageCache.text:
At Weston Green School, we believe that school life extends beyond the classroom. Our vibrant programme of extracurricular clubs offers pupils the chance to explore a wide range of interests. These clubs are a vital part of our school community. They provide opportunities for every child to discover new skills and develop their passions.
Extracurricular clubs help children to grow in confidence. They also build friendships with pupils from different year groups. At Weston Green School, we see our clubs as a chance for pupils to learn about themselves.
A Wide Range of Activities
Weston Green School is proud to offer a diverse selection of extracurricular clubs. Our offerings cater to many different interests. Pupils can join a sports club to improve their fitness and teamwork. They might prefer a creative club like art or drama.
For those with academic interests we offer clubs that extend learning. These could include science investigators or a creative writing group. The range of extracurricular clubs ensures there is something for everyone.
Fostering Skills and Friendships
Joining a club is a fantastic way for children to develop key life skills. Clubs provide a relaxed environment for pupils to collaborate. They learn the importance of teamwork and communication in a fun setting. This helps them to feel more confident both in and out of school.
Our extracurricular clubs are a place where children can try something new without pressure. They can make mistakes and learn from them. This helps to build resilience and a can do attitude.
Clubs for Every Age
We ensure that our extracurricular clubs are suitable for a range of ages. The club offerings change seasonally to reflect pupils’ interests. Staff members who are passionate about their subjects lead many of the clubs. This enthusiasm is contagious and makes learning even more enjoyable.
From sports to the arts to academic pursuits, our extracurricular clubs are a key feature of school life at Weston Green School. We encourage every pupil to get involved. Our clubs are designed to inspire and enrich the educational journey of every child.

pageCache.pageTitle: Nursery in Surrey | Weston Green School
pageCache.text:
Bright Beginnings at our Pre Prep Nursery
Our Little Prep Nursery in Surrey at Weston Green School is dedicated to fostering curiosity and ambition for children aged two to four. We provide a warm, nurturing, and inspiring environment where children flourish from their very first steps in education.
Set within the grounds of our thriving prep school, our nursery at Weston Green provides the perfect balance of comfort, adventure, and purpose. Conveniently situated between Thames Ditton and Esher stations, Little Prep Nursery is ideal for families in Thames Ditton, Esher and Surbiton, as well as the surrounding towns and villages.
Get your child off to the best start at our pre prep nursery. Whether you are ready to apply or would like to learn more, our team is here to help.
Nursery Curriculum at Weston Green
Children at our nursery in Surrey follow our bespoke Bright Beginnings curriculum. Grounded in the Early Years Foundation Stage and enriched with purposeful play and exciting themes, our curriculum helps children develop the confidence, independence and curiosity they need to thrive.
From role-play cafes and outdoor science experiments to traditional tales and music sessions, children are immersed in meaningful learning experiences that feel natural and joyful. Every child at our pre prep nursery is encouraged to wonder, explore and discover in ways that are right for them.
Specialist Teaching in our Nursery
Our specialist teaching provision sets Weston Green apart from other nursery settings in Thames Ditton and the surrounding areas.
Our pre prep nursery offers specialist teaching designed to enrich the early learning period. Children take part in weekly specialist sessions in music, French, sport and Movement and Mindfulness. Our subject leaders also bring their expertise to themed enrichment days like Little Inventors, Maths Treasure Hunt and World Book Wonder Day.
The learning continues beyond the classroom through trips and visits that connect with our curriculum. Whether it is a visit to the farm, a woodland walk or a visit from a local artist, these experiences make learning real, relevant and exciting.
Future Ready
Preparation for Reception begins the moment children join our Little Prep nursery in Surrey. From building friendships to developing independence and self-care, every part of the day is designed to help children grow into confident learners who are ready for the next stage.
Children begin to explore early phonics, mark-making and maths mastery in ways that are engaging and developmentally appropriate. In their final year with us, pre-reception children begin more structured sessions while still enjoying the play and discovery that define early childhood.
SkillQuest
Our SkillQuest programme begins in Little Prep, helping children build life-ready skills through stories, songs and conversation. We focus on developing imagination, resilience, empathy, decision-making and the confidence to try new things.
These early foundations support success in school and beyond.
Our Values at Weston Green Nursery
At Weston Green, our values of ambition, curiosity and kindness are lived every day. At our Nursery in Surrey, children are encouraged to aim high, ask questions and treat others with care.
From classroom routines to outdoor play, our values shape a community where children feel safe, supported and celebrated.
Above all, we value childhood and our convenient positioning enables busy working families from Thames Ditton, Esher, Surbiton and the surrounding areas, to take advantage of the best nursery provision, educational stepping stone and consistent, high-quality care for their children.
Daily Life in Our Nursery
Every day at our Little Prep Nursery follows a calm and purposeful rhythm. Mornings are filled with structured exploration while afternoons offer child-led discovery. Children enjoy hot meals, quiet rest time, engaging story sessions and rich time outdoors.
For those who need it, extended care is also available.
A Seamless Journey into School Life
As part of Weston Green School, our nursery in Surrey provides a smooth transition into our prep school. Children are fully integrated into school life, sing shared facilities and taking part in wider school activities.
By the time they move on, they are confident, familiar with their surroundings, and ready to succeed.
Ready for Reception
As both a nursery and a prep school, we offer a seamless transition from one to the other. This starts with a taster session to get children used to the idea primary education and how it works.
This gentle transition help our pupils enter into primary education with confidence.
Enrol at Weston Green Nursery Today
At Weston Green, our Nursery in Surrey is committed to giving every child at our nursery the best possible introduction to schooling. With fun and engaging group activities, a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere, and wonderful, nurturing teachers, we help our children thrive.
Enquire now to get started on the enrolment process for your child. Questions or concerns? Get in touch with our team for more information on how we make sure every child feels welcome and included.
Curriculum
Children at Little Prep follow our bespoke Bright Beginnings curriculum. Grounded in the Early Years Foundation Stage and enriched with purposeful play and exciting themes, the curriculum helps children develop the confidence, independence and curiosity they need to thrive.
From role-play cafes and outdoor science experiments to traditional tales and music sessions, children are immersed in meaningful learning experiences that feel natural and joyful. Every child is encouraged to wonder, explore and discover in ways that are right for them.
Specialist Teaching
Children benefit from weekly specialist sessions in music, French, sport and Movement and Mindfulness. Our subject leaders also bring their expertise to themed enrichment days like Little Inventors, Maths Treasure Hunt and World Book Wonder Day.
The learning continues beyond the classroom through trips and visits that connect with our curriculum. Whether it is a visit to the farm, a woodland walk or a visit from a local artist, these experiences make learning real, relevant and exciting.
Future Ready
Preparation for Reception begins the moment children join Little Prep. From building friendships to developing independence and self-care, every part of the day is designed to help children grow into confident learners who are ready for the next stage.
Children begin to explore early phonics, mark-making and maths mastery in ways that are engaging and developmentally appropriate. In their final year with us, pre-Reception children begin more structured sessions while still enjoying the play and discovery that define early childhood.
SkillQuest
Our SkillQuest programme begins in Little Prep, helping children build life-ready skills through stories, songs and conversation. We focus on developing imagination, resilience, empathy, decision-making and the confidence to try new things. These early foundations support success in school and beyond.
Values
At Weston Green, our values of ambition, curiosity and kindness are lived every day. Children are encouraged to aim high, ask questions and treat others with care. From classroom routines to outdoor play, our values shape a community where children feel safe, supported and celebrated.
Daily Life
Every day at Little Prep follows a calm and purposeful rhythm. Mornings are filled with structured exploration while afternoons offer child-led discovery. Children enjoy hot meals, quiet rest time, engaging story sessions and rich time outdoors. For those who need it, extended care is also available.

pageCache.pageTitle: A day in the life of Little Prep | Prep School Surrey | Weston Green
pageCache.text:
Rhythm, purpose and joy from morning to home time
Every day at Little Prep is a new adventure. Our carefully structured routine gives children the freedom to explore with confidence while providing the consistency they need to feel safe, settled and ready to learn.
From the moment they arrive, children are welcomed into a calm and purposeful environment where curiosity leads and kindness is lived.
A warm welcome and gentle start
Each morning begins with a warm greeting and time to settle into play. Our smooth and supportive drop-off allows children to transition happily from home to school, ready to begin their day with confidence. Families are invited to share any updates so that each child’s experience is connected, thoughtful and personal.
Morning: bright beginnings and focused learning
The day begins with carpet time where children gather for songs, storytelling and shared learning. This sets the tone for the day and brings the group together.
Small group sessions then follow, led by our experienced educators. Children explore phonics, maths games, early writing and mark-making activities tailored to their stage of development. Each child is supported and stretched in the way that suits them best.
A rolling snack and mindfulness moment gives children time to recharge, reflect and continue learning in a calm and connected way.
Midday: movement, creativity and discovery
After a nourishing hot lunch served in the dining hall, the afternoon opens up to child-led discovery. Children explore outdoors, take part in themed play, or enjoy specialist sessions in sport, French, music and Movement and Mindfulness.
Whether building with blocks, painting, exploring water or playing collaboratively, this is a time where curiosity leads and relationships deepen.
Quiet time and rest
Rest is an important part of the day. For those who nap, we offer peaceful, comfortable sleep spaces with soft lighting and calm music. For others, there are quiet corners to read, relax or take part in gentle activities. This time supports wellbeing and ensures children have the energy to engage fully in the rest of the day.
End of day: reflection and connection
The day ends with storytime and reflection, helping children process their experiences and feel proud of what they have achieved. Our pick-up routine is calm and welcoming, with optional extended care and enrichment available for those who stay a little longer.
Every day matters
At Little Prep, no two days are the same, but every day is filled with purpose. From meaningful learning to joyful play, every moment is designed to build confidence, spark curiosity and nurture kindness.
Our rhythm supports children to thrive, laying strong foundations for a happy and successful journey into Reception and beyond.

pageCache.pageTitle: Our Approach & Values | Prep School Surrey | Weston Green
pageCache.text:
At Weston Green School, our values of ambition, curiosity, and kindness guide everything we do. These principles shape our classrooms, inspire our playtimes, and influence every strategic decision we make.
Ambition
Ambition drives our commitment to empowering every child to aim high and achieve their personal best. In the classroom, ambition means encouraging pupils to embrace challenges, set meaningful goals, and celebrate progress. Beyond academics, ambition fuels the desire to grow as individuals—exploring talents, developing resilience, and aspiring to make a positive impact on the world.
Curiosity
Curiosity lies at the heart of learning at Weston Green. We inspire pupils to ask questions, explore new ideas, and approach the world with a sense of wonder. In every subject, from science experiments to creative writing, curiosity sparks innovation and deeper understanding. It also extends beyond lessons, fostering a lifelong love of discovery in our pupils.
Kindness
Kindness is the cornerstone of our school community. Whether helping a friend, sharing a smile, or celebrating diversity, we embed kindness in every interaction. In the classroom, kindness nurtures collaboration and mutual respect, while on the playground, it builds a culture of empathy and inclusion. Through acts of kindness, we teach our pupils the value of caring for others and themselves.
